meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 处理前端或界面工作时,会先加载设计、性能等规则集,并先建立 DESIGN.md 设计文档再写代码;之后用真实浏览器做性能审计(以 Lighthouse 100 为目标)和视觉比对,最后给出结果。
howto.when: 当请求涉及前端、界面或视觉相关工作,或提到 “frontend”“UI”“UX” 等关键词时触发;也用于性能审计、视觉打磨、品牌风格参考等任务。

say.text: 帮我设计一个落地页,参考 Linear 官网的风格。
say.note: 会先建立 DESIGN.md,再按该品牌规范实现页面。

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 审计当前页面,并把性能修复到满分。
say.note: 会用真实浏览器跑多轮取中位数,再按报告修复。

say.text: 这个按钮的交互太生硬,加一些流畅的动效。
say.note: 会先查 beui.dev 案例,再实现动效。

howto.what_en: On frontend/UI work, Claude loads design/perf rulesets, enforces DESIGN.md first, then codes and audits against it with real-browser Lighthouse (100) and pixel-level QA.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for frontend/UI/UX work, mentions design, styling, or brand references; also for performance audits and visual QA.

say_en.text: Design a landing page referencing Linear's official style.
say_en.note: It creates DESIGN.md first, then implements per that brand.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on this page, targeting a score of 100.
say_en.note: Runs real-browser audits, takes median, fixes per report.

say_en.text: This button's interaction feels stiff; add some smooth animations.
say_en.note: It maps beui.dev patterns to DESIGN.md motion tokens.
